actions.action: Confirm and freeze the exact selection
actions.mechanism: Separate visible-page selection from all-match selection, then bind confirmation to an immutable list of explicit IDs.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-operable “Select these 25” and “Select all 600 matching.” Confirm count, filter summary, and target status; retain that summary during execution.
actions.check: With a screen reader, confirm all matches, change filters, and verify every submitted ID belongs to the original confirmed set.
actions.risk: If selection resolution fails, disable confirmation rather than show an estimated count.

actions.mechanism: Atomic per-record version checks prevent intervening edits from being silently overwritten during a long-running operation.
actions.implementation: Capture versions alongside confirmed IDs. At each write, compare the current version atomically; return a conflict outcome on mismatch.
actions.check: Modify one selected record between confirmation and execution. Verify that record remains untouched while unchanged records receive their requested status.
actions.risk: Separate preflight reads cannot close the race; backend write guards are required.

actions.mechanism: A durable outcome ledger separates successes, retryable failures, conflicts, and unresolved requests without rebuilding selection from filters.
actions.implementation: Persist per-ID outcomes and idempotency keys. Offer keyboard-accessible “Retry failed”; reconcile unresolved requests first, and require renewed confirmation for conflicts.
actions.check: Inject mixed failures and a lost response. Verify retry excludes recorded successes, uses only confirmed IDs, and announces remaining failures.
actions.risk: Without server-side deduplication or outcome lookup, lost responses cannot be safely retried.

actions.mechanism: Each successful change carries its prior status, reversal deadline, and resulting version, making eligibility independently explainable.
actions.implementation: Atomically reverse only before the deadline and when the resulting version still matches. Show keyboard-reachable reasons: “Ten minutes elapsed” or “Record changed afterward.”
actions.check: Test eligible, expired, subsequently changed, and deadline-crossing reversals. Verify outcomes and screen-reader-readable explanations, including when both restrictions apply.
actions.risk: Displayed eligibility can become stale; execution must recheck both conditions.
